name: meta-capi
description: Meta Conversions API: sends a server-side Lead event to Meta for each form submission, with hashed contact details, to back up the browser pixel.

pixel_id.title: Pixel ID
pixel_id.description: The numeric ID of the Meta pixel (dataset) that receives the events.

access_token.title: Access token
access_token.description: Stored here and never shown again.

graph_version.title: Graph API version
graph_version.description: The Graph API version the events are sent to, for example v26.0.

site_url.title: Site address
site_url.description: The public address of the site, for example https://example.com. Sent as the page the event came from. Leave empty to omit it.

event_name.title: Event name
event_name.description: The event sent for each form submission.

forms.title: Forms
forms.description: Form slugs to send events for. Empty = all forms.

email_field.title: Email field
email_field.description: Name of the form field that holds the email address.

phone_field.title: Phone field
phone_field.description: Name of the form field that holds the phone number, with the country code.

name_field.title: Name field
name_field.description: Name of the form field that holds the full name.

consent_field.title: Consent field
consent_field.description: Optional. When set, an event is sent only if this form field is ticked or answered yes.

test_event_code.title: Test event code
test_event_code.description: Optional. The code from Events Manager > Test events. Events carry it while it is set, so they show up as test events.
